Processing_Method: For each climate station: compute linear regression slope (mm/year) on annual rainfall totals over the available record (minimum 15 years). Interpolate station trend values to a gridded surface using IDW or Kriging (method per CLD01). Multiply by 10 to express as mm/decade. Mask ocean and non-study areas.
Key_QC_Rules: Range: -300 to +300 mm/decade plausible for West Africa; flag extremes. Significance (p<0.10) required before labelling 'significant trend'. Document record length per station. Minimum 15-year record required for inclusion in trend surface.

Processing_Method: Same approach as G38 but for mean annual temperature. Apply lapse-rate correction (DEC02) to remove elevation bias before computing trend. Express trend as °C/decade.
Key_QC_Rules: Range: -0.5 to +1.0 °C/decade plausible for Nigeria. Flag stations with trend > 1.0 °C/decade as outliers. Cross-validate with ERA5 reanalysis trend.

Processing_Method: Compute monthly SPI-12 (12-month Standardised Precipitation Index) for each station over the full record. Calculate proportion of months classified as D2 or worse (SPI < -1.30). Interpolate to raster surface. Document gamma distribution fitting per station.
Key_QC_Rules: SPI computation requires >= 30-year record for robust distribution fitting; flag stations below this threshold. Cross-check with SPEI where temperature data available. Output: proportion 0–1 (higher = more frequent drought).

Processing_Method: Download CORDEX-Africa RCP4.5 and RCP8.5 ensemble members. Bias-correct using quantile-delta mapping against observed G22 baseline (1985–2014). Compute multi-model ensemble mean and standard deviation for 2030–2060 mean annual rainfall. Produce: ensemble mean; uncertainty band (1 SD); signal-to-noise ratio.
Key_QC_Rules: Must report: number of models in ensemble (minimum 3); scenario (RCP4.5 / RCP8.5); baseline period; bias-correction method. Flag grid cells where signal-to-noise < 1 (uncertain projection). Projections are not forecasts — label as 'scenario-based projection'.

Processing_Method: Normalise G38 trend (adverse = more negative rainfall or more positive temperature) to 0–100. Normalise G40 drought frequency to 0–100. Where available incorporate G41 projection signal. Weighted aggregation: Rainfall trend 35% + Temperature trend 30% + Drought frequency 25% + Projection signal 10%. Produce community-level CC_Score.
Key_QC_Rules: Weights must be pre-approved. Method pre-specified before computation. Cross-check: communities near coast should have higher temperature trend scores than inland (SST influence). Missing component → partial score with flag.
